answer: I did not run the job. I asked the IQM API for garnet's dynamic architecture, and it reports 20 qubits (QB1 to QB20). garnet:mock also has 20. A 30-qubit GHZ circuit needs 30 qubits, so it cannot run on garnet. I submitted no jobs and spent no credits. You have two options. You can run a GHZ circuit with 20 or fewer qubits on garnet. You can also pick a backend that has at least 30 qubits.
